title: Defensive programming: Python client/agent message validation
description:
Python client and agent trust server messages without validation.

1. client.py — welcome fields (seat, game_id) silently default to empty string if missing
2. agent.py — state fields (status, turn) assumed present, empty defaults cause infinite loops
3. No validation that state_sync contains expected structure

Fix: Validate required fields in welcome messages (raise on missing). Validate state_sync structure. Add timeout/fallback for agent turn detection when fields are missing.
close_reason: Validate welcome seat/game_id, state_sync full_state dict, sequence type in Python client.
